ns2:course.label: Business of Lighting Design
ns2:course.description: Practical approach to working as a lighting designer in professional theatre, including working in non-traditional spaces, regional theatres, touring shows, designing in foreign countries, working on new plays, the role of an assistant, and finding work and negotiating contracts. At least two field trips will be required. Enrollment limited to Theatre majors. Prerequisite: THEA 231, THEA 232, and THEA 432.
